content: Sawtei leh le no le paw kong
Naaning sawtei a cangpaw sahlo, naa no naa paw aa reinge my lo, ma cawh Abuipaw dupaw a cang. Zecawtamaw tatah no le paw reinge cawh ahmangpaw a cang.
“Na no le na paw cizaw my lo,” tahpaw cawh biakangnah kha a peitlepaw biapeh a hmetaw caipaw a cang.
Ma bia cawh naa nge caco, “Naa cawtah chah ka, aluicung lehei naa hringkhua a sy a.”
Naaning paw sahlo, naa sawtei leh khah aa thingaesah khe lo; Abuipaw cawngpahnah le chinghringnah tukhei changchysah hri my lo.
Sae le abui sahlo
Naaning sae sahlo, alui letei naa bui leh khah Khri a rei naa ngepaw hrakhei cizawnah le thinglung hmuisui teitah aa reinge my lo.
Aa mehmuh letah pachaw naa cang nápaw cawtah longlong aa rei cawh nge khe la, Khri sae a cangpaw sahlo tei Khazing dunah aa tuapaw hratah naa lung hmuisui tah tua my lo.
Cawngsaw rai cang be, Abuipaw rai a cang tatah lungtho teitah hre my lo.
Zecawtamaw tatah Abuipaw taco cawngsaw maikaw khah sae a cang zong, a zalongpaw a cang zong chahnah aa tuapaw naning tei hrakhei longmai a pae he tahpaw cawh naa hni.

Taico naaning abui sahlo, ma hraco naa sae sahlo khah mingkai la, pachih parong khe lo. Aaning kha, naaning kha naa phuhning cawtah Bui a cangpaw Abuipaw cawh vaicung letah ung ka, ahohmai du le hua patlia be tahpaw khah hnih my lo.
Khazing raedynah chaichi
A changnah letah co Abuipaw le a hmingtuakhynah thawtlungnah letah a cy pawtah ung my lo.
Khazing a raedynah chaichi a tlingpaw khah a hrei la, ma pawsui co Setan reipasawhnah le dungkheinah khah naa dawcakhai khy he ceh.

Zecawtamaw tatah Kaaning tei kaa dypaw carae cawh thi le saw khatah a cangpaw khah cang lytah uhtu sahlo, nawhnuinah sahlo, ma khazaw muinah hmingtuakhynah le cung lang letei a ungpaw thlawpaw pialuipaw thawtlungnah sahlo khah kaa dy hripaw a cang hi.

Macawtaco Khazing a raedynah chaichi a tlingpaw cawh a hrei la, ma pawsui co ning achaw lypaw a va chua tihtah a dawcakhai khy he ceh ka, zezongpui naa tua khy tai zong tah na daw paria khy thlang he ceh.
Mataico cyky tah a daw la, biahmuisui tesong khah naa te letah a song my lo. Mataico naa cacanghnaw a pachawngkhainah pho cawtah khei dingnah khah a lah la,
arainah thawngchawbia taitah a va chuhpaw a maipacianah khah naa phe letah a pakong my lo.
Ma vytei taihei zingnah khah pho cawtah khei a lah la, ma pawsui co mehchaw lypaw Setan tei a ca kawnah pawhe melui hratah a cangpaw caitai khah naa chaiseh khy a.
Lukhu cawtah pachahnah khah a khu la, Thlawpaw zyzi a cangpaw Khazing bia khah a lah my lo.
Taico, zezong maikaw letah nawpawnah le thlawchangnah a phingphing khei Thlawpaw letah thlawchang my lo. Ma lungpho hmo co a hrah la, mehpathai vytei cawtah thlawchang paria my lo.
Bia ka rei tihtah Khazing tah ka hmokaw a pa hmang nápaw cawtah le thawngchawbia biaparuh cawh cinah hnui lytah ka reilai khy nápawtah ka cawtah thlawchang my lo.
Zecawtamaw tatah bahrairui chi tei thawngchawbia aly lang a seipaw ka cangpaw cawh ma cawpaw tahei a cang hi. Ka rei ruapaw khah ci lytah ka rei khy nápawtah ka cawtah thlawchang my lo.
A changnah kihtlenah
Duchuipaw uny le Abuipaw a sae zingchuipaw a cangpaw Taikhika tah zezongpui khah a ca ching tae he a, ma pawsui co ka tuapaw le ka chuacangnah khah naaning sahlo zong tah naa hnithai a.
Ka konglang naa hnithai nápawtah le thawzaang ca pei na he seh tah cawpaw tah ama heh naaning kha ka va thlawpaw a cang hi.
Paw Khazing le Abuipaw Zisu Khri taitei zingnah khatah a cangpaw donah le thlawlungnah cawh uny a cangpaw naaning sahlo khatah ung ky seh.
A chang thai lypaw doná tei kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri a dopaw sahlo naa cung letah Khazing ningdonah cawh ung ky seh.
